To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DNA undergoes structural changes in the presence of UV and gamma radiation and the extent of change in the helix-coil transition is more in polynucleotide complex than DNA-drug complex.
DNA is a dynamic polymer and is sensitive to its environment.
UV and gamma radiation induced structural changes and destabilization in DNA and the effect of drugs was found to be more pronounced in the presence of D2O.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of DNA in different environments.
the study of the structure and conformation of DNA under different environmental conditions and the effect of radiation and drugs on it.
the study of DNA structure, its stability and conformational transitions in the presence of different environmental conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the structure of DNA is highly sensitive to the environmental changes and the changes in the structure are reflected in the melting temperature.
the structure of DNA in solution is a function of the solvent and the environmental conditions.
the DNA is more sensitive to radiation in H2O than in D2O, which may be due to the fact that H2O is a better solvent than D2O and hence, more effective in causing structural changes in DNA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the helix-coil transition in DNA is influenced by the environment, and the nature of the environment can be studied by the change in the Tm value.
the helix-coil transition is a useful tool in the study of DNA structure.
the DNA is a highly stable molecule which can withstand different types of stresses.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the melting behaviour of DNA can be used to probe the structural stability and conformational change in the DNA molecule.
DNA is not a static entity but a dynamic structure that can be altered by different types of radiative and non-radiative processes.
the DNA molecule is a dynamic structure and its structure can be altered by different environmental factors.
